newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Essence completes Eu Yan Sang offer.
newsitem.headline: HK Essence completes Eu Yan Sang offer.

text.p: Essence Holdings Ltd has completed a general offer for Chinese medicine manufacturer Eu Yan Sang (Hong Kong) Ltd (EYS-HK), Singapore-based Eu Yan Sang International Pte Ltd said in a statement on Monday.
Essence had bought 97.4 percent of EYS-HK and would buy the remaining 2.6 percent under compulsory purchase provisions of the Hong Kong companies ordinance, it said.
The general offer was valued at HK$229 million at the offer price of HK$1.25 per share.
Trading of EYS-HK shares would be suspended on the Hong Kong bourse on October 22 and the company would apply for the withdrawal of its listing upon the completion of the purchase by Essence.
